data.name: 2-HOUR FLAGSHIP GUIDED JET SKI TOUR - PERRY MARINA
data.headline: The only 2-hour guided jet ski tour in Key West — full island circumnavigation
data.description:
Six Fins is the only jet ski operator in Key West offering a full two-hour guided island circumnavigation — competitors run the same 28-mile route in 90 minutes, we run it slower, with stops, on brand-new Yamaha VX Waverunners. Your USCG-licensed lead guide narrates landmarks, points out marine life, and keeps the group together. Available from the Perry Hotel & Marina.

Quick facts:

• 2 hours 
• Perry Hotel & Marina 
• USCG-licensed lead guide 
• Brand-new Yamaha VX Waverunners
• Small-group format


**Good to know before you book**

**Florida boater safety card** — If you were born on or after January 1, 1988, Florida law requires an approved boating safety course and a Boating Safety Education ID card to operate a jet ski. Bring it with you. No card, no problem — you can still ride as a passenger.

**Waivers** — Everyone riding, including minors, signs the Florida Personal Watercraft Agreement and our rental waiver. We email them with your confirmation. Sign before you arrive and you'll be on the water faster.

**Age** — Drivers must be 16 or older. Passengers as young as 6 can ride along with an adult.

**Arrive 30 minutes early** — Check-in and your safety briefing take time. Coming early protects your full ride time.

**Limits** — Max 530 lbs and 3 riders per jet ski: one driver plus up to 2 passengers.

data.highlights:
Our action-packed 28-mile tour takes you around Key West's breathtaking coastline, stopping at five to six prime locations that showcase the area’s stunning natural beauty and vibrant marine life. 

We begin at The Perry Hotel & Marina — 7025 Shrimp Road at Coconut Row, Dock J, Slip 1 — where you’ll feel the excitement build as we embark on our adventure. 

As we leave the harbor and head west, our first stop is the Southernmost Point, a famous landmark where you can snap a photo of the iconic buoy marking the southernmost tip of the continental United States.

Alternatively, if we are heading east, we glide to the Boca Chica Sandbar, a hidden gem known for its soft sands and crystal-clear waters. Here, you can take a refreshing dip, relax on the beach, or soak in the sun while enjoying the stunning views of the surrounding keys.

As we continue our journey, we’ll venture into the tranquil waters of the Florida Keys Wildlife Sanctuary. This area is rich in biodiversity, and you’ll have the chance to spot playful dolphins and graceful sea turtles as they swim alongside us. Our guides will share fascinating facts about the local ecosystem and the importance of preserving this beautiful environment.

We’ll tour the harbor and stop at Higgs Beach, where you can take in the picturesque scenery and maybe even catch a glimpse of the local birdlife, including colorful tropical birds that frequent the area.

Our guides will ensure you feel comfortable and confident throughout the tour, providing tips for beginner and experienced riders. With plenty of opportunities to pause, explore, and take photos, this jet ski adventure promises to be a thrilling and memorable way to experience the best of Key West's coastline. So get ready for an unforgettable ride that combines excitement with the beauty of nature!

The weather will determine the route or modifications thereof.

data.booking_notes:
IMPORTANT: Please read before your tour. This confirmation contains safety rules, arrival details, and required actions.

Dear Guests,

We’re thrilled to host your upcoming jet ski tour with Six Fins Jet Ski Rental in the beautiful oceans of Key West, Florida. To ensure a smooth and unforgettable experience, please review the important information below.

Waivers - 

Insurance
• All Drivers and passengers must sign the liability waiver. Parents and guardians sign for minors. Please sign before arriving for your tour [here:](https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/2d6tk6rpsccd3k2bqcfeui/web/)

Livery Attestation
•  All Drivers and passengers must sign the livery waiver. Parents and guardians sign for minors. Please sign before arriving for your tour [here:](https://waiver.smartwaiver.com/w/mbsnn3yekudiwguswyjbhr/web/)

Boater Safety Course - Drivers Only
• Drivers born after Jan 1, 1988, must complete a Temporary Boater Safety Course (and bring proof) [here:](https://boattests101.com/united-states/florida/florida-rental?mcid=6mu7rail). The fee is $9.99.

✅ Tip: Take the boater test BEFORE you arrive. Otherwise, you must arrive at least 1 hour early to allow time to complete and pass.

Tour Summary
🕒 Duration: 2 hours | Distance: 28 miles
📍 Location: The Perry Hotel and Marina, 7025 Shrimp Road at Coconut Row, Dock J Slip 1, Key West, FL 33040 – Walk down the ramp to the dock across the road from the Bad Boy Taqueria & Tequila Restaurant
🕘 Arrival: Please arrive 30 minutes early
👥 Group Size: Max 6 skis | 3 riders per ski (1 driver + up to 2 passengers)
👶 Age Limits: 6+ to ride with an adult, 16+ to drive (alone)

🌊 A note on sargassum (seaweed): The Florida Keys are seeing a heavy seaweed season this year. On some days our guides adjust the tour route — at times around the island's Atlantic side — to steer clear of seaweed-clogged channels and keep your ride safe and smooth. You'll still get the full guided experience: your captain picks the best route each morning based on that day's conditions and reviews it with you at the dock before launch.

What’s Included
• Guided 2-hour tour with an experienced guide
• 2024 Yamaha VX Waverunners
• Resort Day pass to Perry Hotel pools, gym, and restaurants
• 10% discount on Six Fins luxury boat charters for one year [here:](sixfinscharter.com)
• Coast Guard-approved life vests and safety equipment
• Free shuttle service to Perry Hotel from downtown (schedule varies)

Photography
Your guide will take photographs for you and text them to you after the tour!

Tour Highlights
• Southernmost Point – Snap a photo at the iconic marker
• Boca Chica Sandbar – Relax and swim at this hidden gem
• Spot dolphins, sea turtles, and more
• Wrecks
• Free ride areas
Note: Tour route may vary depending on weather conditions.

What to Bring
• Towel
• Sunscreen & sunglasses
• Snacks & non-alcoholic beverages
• We recommend leaving electronics/valuables at the secure dock box

Tips & Payments
• Tips for your guide are greatly appreciated. A typical gratuity is 20% of the base price ($209 per jet ski), or $42.
• Bottled water, $1.00 each.

Policies
Check-In & Requirements
• Insurance Waivers and Boater Safety Course must be completed before arrival. Drivers must also carry photo ID while on the water, as required by Florida law.
• Arrive at least 30 minutes early. If you have not taken the Boater Safety Course, arrive 1 hour early.
• Safety instructions and on-water hand signals are given in English. Every driver must be able to understand them.

Ticket and Boarding Information
• Tours depart promptly. Late arrivals will miss the tour and will not receive a refund.
• Rescheduling is available if the tour is canceled due to weather or other safety concerns.
• Modifications to the tour due to weather or other conditions do not qualify for refunds.
• All minors must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.

Reservation Policy
• Every guest, including children, must have a reservation. 

Cancellation Policy
• Cancellations must be made at least 48 hours before departure to receive a refund.
• Same-day cancellations and no-shows are non-refundable.
• Tickets purchased within 48 hours of departure are non-refundable.

Weather & Conditions Policy
• Tours will not operate in unsafe weather. Six Fins Jet Ski Rental reserves the right to cancel or reschedule for safety.

Alcohol Policy
• No alcohol before the tour. Guests under the influence or with alcohol will not be permitted to ride and will not be refunded.

Privacy Policy
• We may contact you via email about your reservation and for marketing purposes.
• You may opt out of marketing communications at any time.
• Locations may be under video surveillance.
• Photos or videos may be used on social media unless you object in writing.

Responsibility / Damages
The renter is financially responsible for any damage or loss of equipment.

• Repair/replacement charges:
  – Impeller: $1,000
  – Damaged Seats: $500/seat
  – Flooded Engine: $750
  – Lost Key: $70
  – Cracked Hull: $100/sq in
  – Total Loss: $10,000

• $200/day charge applies until unit is rentable again (max $10,000).

Therefore, we strongly recommend that you purchase the Damage Protection Policy Coverage from your concierge or guide at the jet ski dock for only $40. 

Disclaimer
• By riding or operating a jet ski, participants accept all responsibility for their safety and any damage caused.
• Six Fins Jet Ski Rental is not responsible for lost or damaged personal items.

________________________________________
We appreciate your cooperation with these policies and look forward to providing you with an unforgettable jet ski experience!

Best,
David McFadden and the Six Fins Jet Ski Team

Terms & Conditions

If the jet ski is returned in unrentable condition, the renter agrees to pay $200 per day until it is repaired to rentable condition, with a maximum charge of $10,000.

Communication & Ability

Riders must understand safety instructions given in English and be able to communicate with guides during the tour.
Riders must be comfortable swimming unassisted in open water.

Medical Conditions
This tour is not recommended for guests who:

Are pregnant (at any stage)
Have heart conditions, high blood pressure, or a pacemaker
Have back, neck, or joint problems
Have had recent surgery
Have any condition that could be aggravated by sudden movement, vibration, or impact
